svg.title: Data Center Docket proposed public evidence workflow and five audience outputs
svg.desc: Official money, permission and power acts enter a human reviewed two-independent-act facility gate. BGP and RIPE RIS, DNS and CT, RDAP and ASN, peering, imagery and parcel clues remain support-only. A versioned case then yields distinct municipal DPI, competition, CAP policy, assurance and community or worker questions. Proposal, not a deployed live detector.
